Keybindings.ToggleHudName: Collapse or expand the combat HUD
Keybindings.ToggleHudHint: Switches between the full and compact Smoother Fight HUD while combat is running.
Keybindings.ToggleHudVisibilityName: Show or hide the entire combat HUD
Keybindings.ToggleHudVisibilityHint: Shows or hides the entire Smoother Fight HUD while combat is running. B is assigned by default only when the key is still free.
Keybindings.CollapseCombatActionsHint: Collapses all open attack, spell, and defense actions in the combat HUD.
Keybindings.OpenLatestCombatActionHint: Opens only the latest combat action and brings it into view.

Settings.EnabledHint: Automatically shows the Smoother Fight HUD while a combat is running.
Settings.HideSystemBarName: Hide Splittermond action bar during combat
Settings.HideSystemBarHint: Hides the normal bottom action bar only while this combat HUD is visible.
Settings.ShowCardsHint: Shows recent attack, defense, and damage cards belonging to the combat directly in the HUD.
Settings.MaxCardsHint: How many recent attacks and their associated damage to offer in the HUD.
Settings.DefenseRecalculationHint: Creates a new attack card using the increased defense after a successful active defense.
Settings.RevealTargetDefensesName: Reveal target Defense, Body Resistance, and Mind Resistance
Settings.RevealTargetDefensesHint: When enabled, players can see a selected target's defenses without Owner or Observer permission. These values are hidden by default.
Settings.AudioEventEnabledHint: Controls whether an audio cue is played for this event.
Settings.AudioEventSoundHint: Selects the audio cue used for this event.
Settings.AudioPreviewHint: Briefly plays the currently selected sound without saving the settings.
Settings.AudioPreviewUnavailable: The sound preview could not be played in this browser.
Settings.AudioMenuHint: Manages personal combat cues stored in this world.
Settings.AudioHint: These combat cues are stored for your user in this world and apply across devices.
Settings.AudioSaved: Your personal combat cues were saved in this world.
Settings.AppearanceMenuHint: Manages personal backgrounds, event icons, and motion preferences for this client.
Settings.AppearanceHint: Empty fields use the recognizable default files supplied with the module. Custom files outside the module directory survive updates.
Settings.AppearanceIconDirectoryHint: Optional directory containing active-defense.svg, damage.svg, damage-blocked.svg, spell.svg, ranged.svg, and turn.svg.
Settings.AppearanceMotionHint: System follows the operating system's reduced-motion preference. Animation timing can also be adjusted in styles/themes/default.css.
Settings.AppearanceSaved: Your appearance preferences were saved for this client.
Settings.AudioCustomHint: Select a file from Foundry's data directory or enter an accessible path.
Settings.AudioCustomRequired: A custom sound requires an audio file.
Settings.LinksMenuHint: Links character/NPC sheets and individual tokens to their users.
Settings.LinksTitle: Smoother Fight – users, sheets, and tokens
Settings.LinksHint: Sheet assignments automatically apply to every token created from that sheet. Direct token assignments are intentional exceptions and take priority.
Settings.FallbackLabel: runtime only – does not change assignments
Settings.PrimaryGmHint: When an assigned user is offline, this active GM temporarily takes control. If that GM is offline too, another active GM is selected deterministically.
Settings.NoPrimaryGm: No preferred GM (select an active GM automatically)
Settings.UserOverviewHint: Expand a user to inspect or directly reassign sheets, exceptions, and effective tokens.
Settings.MissingUserWarningDetail: The direct assignment refers to the missing user “{user}”.
Settings.UnresolvedTokenWarningDetail: Not found in any existing scene; stored for {user}.
Settings.DuplicateTokenCleanupHint: The stored sheet assignment or an equivalent surviving token already resolves to the same user. The old references will be removed when you save.
Settings.OpenWarningSheetHint: Opens the character or NPC sheet associated with this stored token assignment.
Settings.PromoteWarningAssignmentHint: Assigns the associated sheet to {user} and removes the orphaned direct token assignment when saving.
Settings.RemoveWarningAssignmentHint: Removes only the orphaned direct token assignment when saving. The sheet assignment remains unchanged.
Settings.PromoteWarningPending: {user} will become the sheet default; the old token reference will be removed when saving.
Settings.RemoveWarningPending: The orphaned token assignment will be removed when saving.
Settings.WarningActorUnavailable: The associated sheet is no longer available.
Settings.AmbiguousOwners: {count} tokens have multiple possible owners and no more specific assignment.
Settings.MissingUsers: {count} direct token assignments refer to users who no longer exist.
Settings.UnresolvedTokens: {count} stored token assignments could not be matched to an existing scene and will be preserved when saving.
Settings.SheetAssignmentsHint: This assignment persists when a token is deleted and later recreated from the same sheet.
Settings.NoSheets: No character or NPC sheets were found.
Settings.TokenAssignmentsHint: Only actual exceptions are shown by default. Inherited and automatic assignments can be included when needed.
Settings.NoTokenFilterResults: No token exceptions match the current filters.
Settings.NoTokens: No tokens were found in the available scenes.
Settings.TokenAssignHint: Set a direct exception for {token}. It takes priority over sheet and primary-GM assignments.
Settings.TokenAssignmentCleared: The direct assignment for {token} was removed; sheet and fallback rules apply again.

HUD.NoTargetDetail: Target with T or use the target menu.
HUD.NoOwner: Only owners of this token can use its actions.
HUD.SelectOwnedToken: Choose one of your combatants from the menu or canvas.
HUD.FavoriteSkillSet: {skill} was marked as a favorite skill.
HUD.FavoriteSkillCleared: {skill} is no longer marked as a favorite skill.
HUD.FavoriteSkillLimit: No more than {max} skills can be marked as favorites.
HUD.DefaultAttackSet: {attack} was set as the default attack.
HUD.DefaultAttackCleared: {attack} is no longer the default attack.
HUD.TickActionEmpty: No fixed action in the reference takes exactly {ticks} tick(s).

standUpProne.Name: Stand up (prone)
standUpProne.Description: The character rises fully from a prone position.

standUpKneeling.Name: Stand up (sitting/kneeling)
standUpKneeling.Description: The character rises from a sitting or kneeling position.

disengage.Name: Disengage
disengage.Description: The character leaves the immediate melee situation in a controlled manner.

dropProne.Name: Drop prone
dropProne.Description: The character immediately drops to the ground and is prone afterwards.

crawl.Name: Crawl
crawl.Description: The character moves along the ground by crawling.

walk.Name: Walk
walk.Description: The character moves across the battlefield at a normal pace.

sprint.Name: Sprint
sprint.Description: The character moves across the battlefield at the fastest possible pace.

meleeAttack.Name: Melee attack
meleeAttack.Description: The character attacks a target in melee reach with a suitable weapon.

opportunityAttack.Name: Opportunity attack
opportunityAttack.Description: The character uses a provoked opportunity to make an immediate melee attack.

searchOpening.Name: Search for an opening
searchOpening.Description: The character observes the opponent and prepares a more precise melee attack.

shieldBash.Name: Shield bash
shieldBash.Description: The character strikes with a wielded shield and deals damage.

readyRangedAttack.Name: Ready
readyRangedAttack.Description: The character readies the ranged weapon and ammunition for the following attack.

aim.Name: Aim
aim.Description: The character takes time to execute the next ranged attack more accurately.

rangedAttack.Name: Ranged attack
rangedAttack.Description: The character releases a previously readied ranged attack against a target.

activeDefense.Name: Active defense
activeDefense.Description: The character attempts to increase resistance against an incoming attack.
activeDefense.Special: check against 15; +1 (+1 per degree) to resistance

evasiveLeap.Name: Evasive leap
evasiveLeap.Description: The character leaps out of the way of a hit to reduce the damage suffered.

escapeGrapple.Name: Escape grapple
escapeGrapple.Description: The character actively attempts to escape an existing grapple.

releaseGrapple.Name: Release grapple
releaseGrapple.Description: The grappler ends a grapple they are maintaining.

catchBreath.Name: Catch breath
catchBreath.Description: The character pauses and recovers from suffered stun damage.

focusMagic.Name: Focus magic
focusMagic.Description: The character gathers the required magic and prepares a spell.

castSpell.Name: Cast spell
castSpell.Description: The character releases a previously focused spell.

dropItem.Name: Drop item
dropItem.Description: The character drops a held item without using it further.

useItem.Name: Use item
useItem.Description: The character employs an item according to its intended function.

simpleCommand.Name: Simple command
simpleCommand.Description: The character gives a creature a short instruction that can be understood immediately.
simpleCommand.Special: Does not interrupt your own continuous action; extends it by 3 ticks. Example: ‘Attack opponent A!’ or ‘Protect character C!’

complexCommand.Name: Complex command
complexCommand.Description: The character gives a creature a more detailed instruction containing several pieces of information.
complexCommand.Special: Does not interrupt your own continuous action; extends it by 5 ticks. Example: ‘Stay here and let nobody pass!’

task.Name: Task
task.Description: The character assigns a multi-step task for a creature to carry out independently.
task.Special: Example: ‘Run over there, fetch the artifact, and bring it here!’

complexTask.Name: Complex task
complexTask.Description: A task this complex or long-term cannot be communicated during an ongoing combat.

collectiveCommand.Name: Collective command
collectiveCommand.Description: The character calls out the same simple command to several creatures at once.
collectiveCommand.Special: Does not interrupt your own continuous action; extends it by 8 ticks. Only a very simple command without tactical instructions; it must be shouted clearly. Example: ‘Attack!’

coordinate.Name: Coordinate
coordinate.Description: The character coordinates several allies to improve their joint approach.
coordinate.Special: Leadership against difficulty 20 plus the number of allies

HUD.ShowPrimaryEventTarget: Show primary target token {target} on the canvas

HUD.FumbleNotAllowed: You do not own the affected character.
HUD.DefenseDamageNotAllowed: Only an owner of the defending character may apply this stun damage.
HUD.DamageTargetMissing: The target stored for this attack is no longer available.
HUD.ActionFailed: The action could not be completed. See the console for details.
HUD.DamageOwnerOnly: Only the attacking actor's owner may select or roll damage.
